about.heading: A School With a Vision Forward
about.intro: Fountainhead Wockhardt Global School (FWGS) is the product of a unique partnership — where the values of an established institution meet the progressive pedagogy of Fountainhead Schools. Today, FWGS is a full IB continuum school offering Early Years, PYP, MYP, and the IB Diploma Programme. The school is committed to nurturing leaders with character and competence — graduates who are globally-minded, locally grounded, and ready for the challenges and opportunities of the 21st century.

timeline.title: Wockhardt Global School Established
timeline.body: The Wockhardt Group establishes Wockhardt Global School in Surat — a forward-thinking institution with a vision for global education.

timeline.title: Fountainhead Schools Joins
timeline.body: Fountainhead Schools partners with Wockhardt Global School, bringing its award-winning IB pedagogy, curriculum expertise, and learning philosophy to the campus — creating Fountainhead Wockhardt Global School (FWGS).

timeline.title: Full IB Continuum & Growing
timeline.body: FWGS now offers the complete IB continuum — Early Years, PYP, MYP, and the Diploma Programme — with a focus on inquiry, international-mindedness, and graduate excellence.

earlyYears.heading: The EYP at FWGS
earlyYears.intro: The Early Years Programme at FWGS is a carefully designed introduction to learning — rooted in the IB philosophy, driven by inquiry, and centred on the whole child.
earlyYears.pillarsHeading: The Four Pillars of EYP at FWGS

pillars.title: PYP Learner Agency
pillars.body: Children are not passive recipients of knowledge — they are active agents of their own learning. At FWGS, we design experiences that give children genuine choice, voice, and ownership of their learning journey from the very beginning.

pillars.title: Inquiry-Based Play
pillars.body: Play is not a break from learning — it is the most powerful form of learning in early childhood. Every activity at FWGS is designed to provoke curiosity, encourage exploration, and develop critical thinking through hands-on, meaningful play.

pillars.title: Social-Emotional Resilience
pillars.body: We develop the emotional vocabulary and resilience that children need to navigate relationships, setbacks, and the complexity of the world. Social-emotional learning is woven into every moment of the school day — not treated as a separate subject.

pillars.title: Environment as Third Teacher
pillars.body: The classroom itself is a learning tool. We design our spaces intentionally — with materials that invite exploration, natural elements that ground children, and displays that reflect and extend their thinking. The environment teaches alongside the teacher.

programmes.title: Early Years Programme
programmes.body: Four pillars: PYP Learner Agency, Inquiry-Based Play, Social-Emotional Resilience, and Environment as Third Teacher.

programmes.title: Primary Years Programme
programmes.body: Six transdisciplinary units of inquiry per year. Collaborative, concept-driven learning through real-world connections.

programmes.title: Middle Years Programme
programmes.body: Eight subject groups with global context. Critical thinking, intercultural awareness, and community service as action.

programmes.title: IB Diploma Programme
programmes.body: Internationally recognised university preparation. Six subject groups, Theory of Knowledge, Extended Essay, and CAS.

admissions.heading: Joining FWGS — The FS Way
admissions.subheading: Our admission process — PAE — is transparent, fair, and centred on the child.

steps.title: Pre-Admission
steps.body: Initial enquiry and campus tour. Meet our admissions team to learn about our programmes, facilities, and the IB continuum.

steps.title: Assessment
steps.body: Age-appropriate interaction. For younger grades, a warm play-based session. For older grades, a casual conversation with our academic team.

steps.title: Enrolment
steps.body: Offer of admission, documentation, fee payment, and welcome orientation. Your child joins the Fountainhead family.

docsRequired: Child & parent photograph (grey background, as on Aadhaar)
Report cards for previous two grades
No-due certificate (hard copy; not for EY)
Original School Leaving Certificate once admission is confirmed

studentLife.heading: Life at FWGS
studentLife.sportsBody: FWGS is committed to the physical development of every student alongside academic achievement. Sports and physical education are integral to the school day — not an add-on.
studentLife.artsBody: FWGS students perform, express, and create through music, drama, and dance. Annual performances and inter-school events give students platforms to share their talent with the world. The arts are not extra-curricular at FWGS — they are central to the development of the whole person the IB seeks to grow.
studentLife.clubsBody: Robotics, Model United Nations, Debate, Photography, Coding, Environmental Action — FWGS students engage in a wide range of clubs and activities that build skills, friendships, and purpose beyond the curriculum. All clubs align with the IB's Action strand — students are encouraged to connect their learning to real-world impact.

wellbeingItems.title: Counselling
wellbeingItems.body: Dedicated counsellors support students' academic choices, university applications, and personal wellbeing throughout their time at FWGS.

wellbeingItems.title: Parent Portal — Nucleus
wellbeingItems.body: FWGS parents have access to Nucleus — for progress tracking, communication, calendars, and school updates. Available on web and iOS.

wellbeingItems.title: CAS — Creativity, Activity, Service
wellbeingItems.body: All IB Diploma students engage in CAS — a core component that develops students as compassionate, active citizens through real-world projects and community service.

wellbeingItems.title: International Mindedness
wellbeingItems.body: FWGS's location and community bring genuine diversity. Students learn to think across cultures, engage with global issues, and act with empathy and understanding.
